title: docs(ai-agents): remove create_connector references after SDK method removal
body:
## What

The SDK no longer exposes `Workspace.create_connector()` (removed in [airbytehq/sonar#4586](https://github.com/airbytehq/sonar/pull/4586)). This PR updates all AI Agents documentation to remove references to `create_connector` and directs users to the web app or REST API for connector creation instead.

The SDK reference docs are autogenerated and not touched here.

Requested by @girarda.

## How

- **interfaces/sdk/add-connector.md**: Rewrote the "Create a connector" section to point to the web app and REST API. Removed all `create_connector` code samples.
- **interfaces/sdk/authenticate.md**: Updated the "Two sets of credentials" note to remove `create_connector` reference.
- **interfaces/sdk/readme.md**: Simplified the end-to-end example to show `connect()` + `execute()` only, without connector creation.
- **interfaces/sdk/workspaces.md**: Updated auto-creation narrative and internal comments.
- **get-started/developer-quickstart/tutorial-langchain.md**: Replaced `setup.py` with instructions to add the connector via the web app or REST API.
- **get-started/developer-quickstart/tutorial-pydantic.md**: Same as above.
- **get-started/developer-quickstart/tutorial-fastmcp.md**: Same as above.
- **interfaces/api/add-connector.md**: Updated cross-reference text.
- **concepts/architecture/connectors-and-credentials.md**: Removed SDK from connector creation interface list.

## Review guide

1. `docs/ai-agents/interfaces/sdk/add-connector.md` - main change
2. `docs/ai-agents/get-started/developer-quickstart/tutorial-langchain.md` - tutorial update
3. `docs/ai-agents/get-started/developer-quickstart/tutorial-pydantic.md` - tutorial update
4. `docs/ai-agents/get-started/developer-quickstart/tutorial-fastmcp.md` - tutorial update
5. Remaining files are small cross-reference fixes

## User Impact

Users reading the SDK docs will no longer see `create_connector` code samples that would fail at runtime. They are directed to the web app or REST API for connector creation.

## Can this PR be safely reverted and rolled back?

- [x] YES 💚

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/eee1bf55cedc4ee8ad12f9e3a1063525
